name: io.github.MeMikko/hoodgrow-mcp
description: Robinhood Chain stock token data — price, split-adjusted supply, DeFi, corporate actions, movers.

environmentVariables.name: HOODGROW_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Free bearer API key from https://www.hoodgrow.com/profile. Optional if HOODGROW_PRIVATE_KEY is set instead.

environmentVariables.name: HOODGROW_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: EVM private key used to pay per call via x402 instead of a bearer key. Optional if HOODGROW_API_KEY is set instead.

environmentVariables.name: HOODGROW_USE_CREDITS
environmentVariables.description: Set to "true" (only meaningful alongside HOODGROW_PRIVATE_KEY) to spend a prepaid credit balance instead of paying x402 per call — buy one first with the buy_credits tool.

environmentVariables.name: HOODGROW_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the API base URL (default https://www.hoodgrow.com) — for testing against a non-production deployment.
